title: Operational fallback seed selection after MOLDISC-006 target-preparation closure
scientific_question: Among the REDOCK-003 seeds that already met the frozen AqSolDB coverage boundary, which remaining seed has the strongest pre-existing operational docking evidence without relying on the MOLDISC-006 heme target?

candidates.block_reason: MOLDISC-006 closed because required HEM target preparation was not supported without new metalloprotein method development.

selection_rule.selection_among_eligible: highest AqSolDB nearest similarity, then case_id ascending

interpretation_boundaries: MOLDISC-007 is an operational seed-selection program using previously observed evidence; it is not an independent validation experiment.
REDOCK-003 rank-1 RMSD is used only as an operational-readiness filter, not as evidence of affinity, potency or efficacy.
AqSolDB similarity indicates measured-solubility structural coverage, not equal solubility.
MOLDISC-006 target-preparation failure excludes 1P2Y from this fallback only because the required HEM preparation is outside the current operational envelope.
Selection of a fallback seed does not establish therapeutic superiority or biological value.
